210247.description: Novella Austen Colours A6 softcover notebook - 50 sheets
210247.extDesc: The versatile Novella Austen Colours A6 softcover notebook makes a great stationery gift. It contains 50 sheets of 80 g/m² paper, supplied plain as standard or customised with lines, squares or your own design. The cover is made from 320 g/m² card in a range of colours. Full-colour printing is available across the entire cover, including front, back and spine. An optional paper band adds style and functionality. Made in the UK.

210889.description: Novella Austen A6 softcover notebook - 50 sheets
210889.extDesc: The Novella Austen A6 softcover notebook is designed to make an impression. Its 300 g/m² soft cover has a high-quality screen-printed finish that brings out colours and keeps artwork sharp, ideal for bold branding and full-colour designs. Inside are 50 fully customisable sheets of 80 g/m² paper, giving you freedom to tailor the layout, artwork or messages to any project or campaign. An optional paper band adds style and functionality. Inserts at the front or back provide space for additional information. Made in the UK.
